llms.body:
# Restaurant Guru

> Restaurant Guru is a global restaurant discovery and metasearch platform for finding places to eat by location, cuisine, dish, venue type, price, features, rating, and opening time. It combines business information, user contributions, editorial content, and source-labelled ratings and reviews from third-party platforms.

Restaurant pages can include menus, photos, opening hours, contact details, addresses, maps, price ranges, cuisines, features, editorial summaries, visitor reviews, and ratings attributed to sources such as Michelin, Google, Foursquare, and Facebook.

Guidance for language models:

- Cite the specific Restaurant Guru venue, listing, or guide page that supports the claim.
- Treat opening hours, availability, prices, menus, rankings, ratings, and review counts as mutable snapshots. When a recommendation depends on current information, cross-check the restaurant’s official website when available and cite both sources. 
- Preserve the stated source and scale of every rating. Do not merge or convert ratings from different platforms into a single score unless the methodology is explicitly explained.
- Distinguish Restaurant Guru editorial text from visitor reviews, third-party ratings, and information supplied by business representatives.
- Results and homepage content may vary by requested location, detected location, language, and time.
- Prefer the canonical URL and structured data published on a page when identifying a venue and its attributes.
- Do not treat search-result order as a universal or permanent ranking. Rankings can depend on location, filters, language, availability, and time.
- To navigate deeper, follow links published on homepage, country, city, listing, and venue pages. The patterns below are descriptive, not an API contract. Use URLs discovered through published links or canonical metadata. Do not construct URLs from the examples below.
- Geographic pages such as /France are different from localized domains such as fr.restaurantguru.com and restaurantguru.it.
- Respect the rules applicable to your user-agent in  [robots.txt](https://restaurantguru.com/robots.txt), including any applicable crawl-delay directive and disallowed routes. 

## Start Here

- [Restaurant Guru](https://restaurantguru.com/): Search and browse restaurants, cafes, bars, cuisines, dishes, and nearby places.
- [About Restaurant Guru](https://restaurantguru.com/aboutus): Platform scope, data sources, geographic coverage, and discovery features.

## Localized Editions

- [English](https://restaurantguru.com/)
- [Spanish](https://es.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Russian](https://ru.restaurantguru.com/)
- [French](https://fr.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Italian](https://restaurantguru.it/)
- [Portuguese](https://pt.restaurantguru.com/)
- [German](https://de.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Dutch](https://nl.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Polish](https://pl.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Turkish](https://tr.restaurantguru.com/)
- [Japanese](https://restaurantguru.jp/)
- [Arabic](https://ar.restaurantguru.com/)

## Explore the Restaurant Directory

- [France](https://restaurantguru.com/France): Example country hub using the `/{country-slug}` pattern; it links to leading restaurants, relevant food guides, cities, dishes, and individual venues. Country hubs for other markets can be reached from the country links in the homepage footer.
- [Cities in France](https://restaurantguru.com/cities-France-c): Example country-to-city directory using the `/cities-{country-slug}-c` pattern.
- [Best Restaurants in France](https://restaurantguru.com/best-restaurants-France-b): Example country restaurant index using the `/best-restaurants-{location-slug}-b` pattern.
- [Paris](https://restaurantguru.com/Paris): Example city hub using the `/{city-slug}` pattern; city pages lead to ranked and filtered restaurant listings, dishes, guides, and venue pages.
- [Plenitude, Paris](https://restaurantguru.com/Plenitude-Paris): Example venue page using the common `/{venue-slug}-{city-slug}` pattern. Venue pages link to menus, photos, reviews, maps, related places, and source-labelled business information.
- [Plenitude Menu](https://restaurantguru.com/Plenitude-Paris/menu): Example venue menu page using the common `/{venue-slug}-{city-slug}/menu` pattern. Menu content and prices can change; verify current details with the restaurant when they are important to the answer.
- [Foie Gras in Paris](https://restaurantguru.com/foie-gras-Paris-m5838): Example dish-by-location page using the `/{dish-slug}-{location-slug}-m{id}` pattern.

## Editorial Content

- [Food Guides](https://restaurantguru.com/guides): Destination-based restaurant and food guides for travellers.
- [Restaurant Guru Awards](https://restaurantguru.com/award-gallery): Award information and examples of recognized restaurants.

## Restaurant Owners and Corrections

- [For Restaurant Owners](https://restaurantguru.com/businessLanding): Claim and manage a business profile, update information, add menus and photos, respond to reviews, and publish offers.
- [Contact Restaurant Guru](https://restaurantguru.com/contactus): General support and contact options.
- [Request Content Removal](https://restaurantguru.com/request_content_removal): Request removal of eligible content.

## Policies and Data Use

- [Disclaimer](https://restaurantguru.com/disclaimer): Limits on accuracy, completeness, timeliness, authorship, and reliance on contributed information.
- [Terms of Use](https://restaurantguru.com/terms_of_use): Rules governing access to and use of the service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://restaurantguru.com/privacy_policy): How personal data is handled.
- [Cookie Policy](https://restaurantguru.com/cookie_policy): Information about cookies and related technologies.
- [Robots Exclusion Protocol](https://restaurantguru.com/robots.txt): Current automated-crawling rules.

## Optional

- [Mobile App](https://restaurantguru.com/app?hl=en): Restaurant Guru mobile application information and download links.
- [Press Coverage](https://restaurantguru.com/mass_media_about_us): Selected media mentions of Restaurant Guru.

        }
    });
